title: Ring modulator EO comb
description: Electro-optic frequency comb from ONE microring modulator (models/optical_field/ring_mod.va): a CW laser (1309.9264 nm, 1 mW) parked on the max-slope side of the ring's resonance (R = 7.5 um, k^2 = 10 %, linewidth 255 pm, cold resonance 1310 nm) while VD drives the depletion electrode with a strong 10 GHz tone (V_ac = 4.53 V, so the resonance sweeps +-1.6 half-linewidths at 45 pm/V). Sweeping the resonance across the laser modulates the through-port field, and the p_comb spectrum probe (turn on Optical spectrum) shows the resulting comb: teeth spaced by the 10 GHz drive, spanning ~+-0.3 nm around 1310 nm. The comb is CAVITY-SHAPED, not flat: the ring's finite photon lifetime (tau/2 = 3.6 ps, f_cav = 44 GHz) low-passes the modulation, so sidebands beyond the cavity linewidth roll off. Raise VD.V to swing the resonance further and grow more teeth; raise VD.freq toward f_cav and the comb bandwidth SATURATES as the cavity can no longer follow (the photon-lifetime limit). examples/eo_comb.py pins every tooth against an independent integration of the ring CMT and plots the bandwidth-vs-f_RF rolloff.
